findings.reason: without a constructed open pulse the whole open-ended guard can pass vacuously, so the section must add one fixture-driven observation alongside the live count.
findings.text: the negative control's second clause ("a pulse the archive returns without an end time is stored as open-ended, never with an invented end") is conditional on data the section says was never measured ("listing the pulses of a category has not yet been measured"), so a run that finds zero open pulses satisfies the control without the absent-end branch ever executing, and the section names no test that constructs a pulse with no end; the declared schema change to optional `end_ns` (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:1929-1933, now `required: true`) therefore has no measurement of its own

findings.reason: the plan simultaneously claims one shape change and requires a stored count the shape cannot hold, so the worker cannot tell whether the schema or the control is wrong.
findings.text: the first control requires "a category the archive lists with no pulses is stored with a count of zero", but PulseCategory carries no count attribute (imas_codex/schemas/facility.yaml:1865-1892: id, facility_id, archive, name, description only), and s16 declares exactly one change to the section 3 shapes, an end time that may be absent, so a worker taking the control literally must make an undeclared second schema change while one reading it loosely records zero memberships

findings.reason: the two sections changed in this version state incompatible pulse expectations, and the endpoint must say the end is reported where the archive gives one.
findings.text: s18's done-when requires the pulse leg to return "the pulses of one of them with start and end times", which s16 now says cannot always be true (a pulse's end may be absent), so the check as written can only pass by selecting a category whose pulses are all closed or by presenting an invented end — the exact behaviour s16's negative control forbids — and nothing measures the open-ended case through the server

findings.reason: the change rests on an unmeasured premise, so the plan should present the open-ended pulse as something the run establishes and report its count as the evidence, rather than assert it beforehand.
findings.text: the section justifies the schema change with "a pulse still running has none", stated as a fact about the archive, while the same paragraph records that listing a category's pulses has not been measured and section 1's measured table holds only the 743 category names and the string identity type
